name: domain-check
description: Track domain expirations and renewal costs across registrars

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b shared backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
